description: Customisable settings for the stagehand app

name.description: Name of the application. Used in the browser tab title and as the name of the auth client

logo_light.description: URL of the logo image to display when using the light theme, e.g. on the login page

logo_dark.description: URL of the logo image to display when using the dark theme, e.g. on the login page

general.description: General settings associated with the app

desks.description: Data associated with desk booking flow

hide_reason.description: Whether to disable ability for user to set a reason on the desk booking confirmation

can_set_host.description: Whether user is allowed to make desk bookings for others

events.description: Data associated with meeting booking flow

can_book_for_others.description: Whether user is allowed to set another user as the host when booking a space from the explore map

search_enabled.description: Whether searching is available on the explore map view

show_qr_for_booking.description: Whether to show a QR code for bookings

push_notification_defaults.description: Default push notification enablement per alert severity level. Merged with the user's saved preferences, which take priority

critical.description: Whether push notifications for critical alerts are enabled by default

high.description: Whether push notifications for high severity alerts are enabled by default

medium.description: Whether push notifications for medium severity alerts are enabled by default

low.description: Whether push notifications for low severity alerts are enabled by default

educational_environment.description: Whether the app is used in an educational environment. When set, room events are labelled as classes, e.g. `Current Class` instead of `Current Event`

snapshot_interval.description: Time in milliseconds between refreshes of camera snapshot images. Defaults to `10000` (10 seconds)

analytics_pages.description: List of analytics dashboards selectable on the analytics page, each embedded in an iframe. The analytics link is only shown in the sidebar when this list is not empty

name.description: Display name for the analytics dashboard

url.description: URL of the analytics dashboard to embed

backoffice_link.description: Base URL of the PlaceOS Backoffice, used for links to view systems and triggers. Defaults to `/backoffice/` on the current origin

service_link.description: Base URL of the room control UI, used for links to control a room. Defaults to `/control/` on the current origin

show_recorder_view.description: Whether to show the recorder streams link in the sidebar
